edges.reason: constructor parameter _nftTicket is stored into state variable nftTicket
constructor parameter _lootNFT is stored into state variable lootNFT
constructor parameter _xlootNFT is stored into state variable xlootNFT
seed parameter flows into the randomGen keccak hash computation
max parameter is used as the modulo bound of the random value
block.timestamp is consumed as randomness entropy, creating timestamp dependence
msg.sender is used as an entropy input of the random generator
caller-controlled msg.sender drives the claim entrypoint balance checks and enumeration
reward tickets are minted directly to the caller msg.sender
selected rewardTicketId element is passed as the minted token id
claimLeft is decremented only after the external safeMint call returns, allowing reentrancy
rewardTicketLeft is decremented after the external safeMint call, leaving state stale during the call
claimLeft state variable is the operand of the claimLeft - 1 arithmetic update
rewardTicketLeft element is the operand of the rewardTicketLeft[i] - 1 arithmetic update
index parameter is divided and masked inside lootIsClaimed
index parameter is divided and masked inside xlootIsClaimed
index parameter determines the word and bit written by _setLootClaimed
index parameter determines the word and bit written by _setXlootClaimed
claimedWordIndex derived from index is used to index the bitmap word
claimedBitIndex derived from index is used to build the bit mask
mask is applied to the bitmap word to compute the claimed result
claimedWord read from storage is compared with mask
_setLootClaimed reads and writes the lootClaimedBitMap bitmap
_setXlootClaimed reads and writes the xlootClaimedBitMap bitmap
lootIsClaimed reads the lootClaimedBitMap storage mapping
xlootIsClaimed reads the xlootClaimedBitMap storage mapping
claim requires claimLeft > 0 and uses it to cap the draw count
rewardTicketLeft elements are accumulated into filter to select the reward bucket
_drawTicket decrements rewardTicketLeft when a ticket is minted
result of randomGen is compared with filter inside _drawTicket
claim calls lootIsClaimed for each Loot token owned by the caller
claim calls xlootIsClaimed for each xLoot token owned by the caller
claim calls _setLootClaimed to mark unclaimed Loot tokens
claim calls _setXlootClaimed to mark unclaimed xLoot tokens
claim loops calling _drawTicket draw times
_drawTicket invokes randomGen to pick the reward bucket
draw local variable bounds the loop that calls _drawTicket
_drawTicket performs an external safeMint call on the untrusted nftTicket token contract before updating state
